description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Magical Blink 1] to all allies, grants [Buff Ice 30% (15s)], [Buff Holy 30% (15s)], [Awoken Invincible General], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Awoken Runic Blade Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Magical Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next non-PHY, non-NIN attack that deals magical, fractional or missing HP damage

description.name: Buff Ice 30% (15s)
description.text: Increases Ice damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Buff Holy 30% (15s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Awoken Invincible General
description.text: Holy and Ice abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy and Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Awoken Runic Blade Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Awoken Runic Blade after using two Ice or Holy abilities
